name: Backrooms Motion
desc:
Explore the depths of the Backrooms across multiple levels, each with unique environments and hidden dangers.
Search lockers for supplies that can help you survive.
Fight off entities, take on other players, or team up to stay alive.

Controls:
 Shift - Sprint
 E - Interact
 C - Crouch
 B - Open Inventory
 J - Open Journal
 Backspace - Drop Items
 P - Open Settings
 T - Toggle PVP
 M - Open menu

⚠️ This game is still in development. Expect updates, changes and occasional bugs.
💡 Flashing lights and visual effects may affect sensitive viewers.
🚫 Exploiting will result in a permanent ban.
